email.subject: Quick note on Peak Co Fitness's site
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I took a look at Peak Co Fitness's site. Two things likely cost you members: there's no way to book a class online, so people checking after hours just leave, and there's no click-to-call on mobile, so anyone searching on their phone can't reach you with one tap.

No pressure, but I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you what I found, including a couple smaller items too.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
